name: safe-vault
title: Safe Vault
description: A photographic safe that opens with a combination: SafeDial on its door, and once the app checks the code and unlocks it, the bolts draw back, the door swings open and the camera moves in to a plaque on the back wall that holds your contents as real DOM, mapped onto the wall in perspective. A wrong code shakes the dial. The three.js scene draws in a worker after the controls paint; without WebGL the drawn door stays and the contents show under it.

[data-vault=\"3d\"] [data-slot=\"safe-va.mask: radial-gradient(var(--screw) at var(--screw-inset) var(--screw-inset), transparent 96%, #000), radial-gradient(var(--screw) at var(--screw-far) var(--screw-inset), transparent 96%, #000), radial-gradient(var(--screw) at var(--screw-inset) var(--screw-far), transparent 96%, #000), radial-gradient(var(--screw) at var(--screw-far) var(--screw-far), transparent 96%, #000)

docs: `<SafeVault label status onStatusChange onComplete value|defaultValue onValueChange length numbers mask disabled name labels>{contents}</SafeVault>`. `status` (`"locked"`, `"denied"` or `"unlocked"`) is yours: check the code from `onComplete` and set it. `denied` shakes the dial, announces `labels.denied` and clears the code, then calls `onStatusChange("locked", { reason: "retry" })` so a second wrong code can be denied again; `unlocked` announces `labels.unlocked`, draws the bolts back, swings the door to 100° and moves the camera onto the plaque (2.8 s; at once under reduced motion). `children` aren't in the page until `status` is `unlocked`, and stay inert until the door is open; once locked they are inert, `aria-hidden` and hidden from agents at once, and leave the page when the door has shut (at once under reduced motion or without the 3D safe); they sit in a region named `labels.contents`, on a plaque laid out at the width it has once the camera settles (so text stays sharp), as tall as they are within the panel, then in a ScrollArea. The plaque is paper on a light page and dark anodised metal on a dark one, from `--card` and `.dark`; restyle `[data-slot="safe-vault-plaque-face"]` or its `--safe-vault-plaque` variables. With `onStatusChange`, an unlocked vault shows a Lock button (`labels.lock`) that asks for `locked`; locking closes the door and clears the code. Agents use the dial's `enter` by the vault's `label`, and press Lock. The dial is SafeDial, so its keys, drag and `labels.dial`/`labels.code` work as there; in 3D its hit area sits over the dial on the door and the 3D dial follows it. The scene (`three` is a dependency, through `three-stage`) draws in a module worker (`safe-vault-worker.js`, built from `new URL(..., import.meta.url)`) or on the page, only while something moves; an unlock or a lock that interrupts the other continues from the exact pose; the plaque is placed on the page from the same camera and start time, with only `transform` and `clip-path` changing per frame.
